about: Exo identity spec v0 (plan §2; §2.14 lists what changed since /1). Bytes are lowercase hex unless a field says otherwise; JSON records are as they travel. Every signature is low-s. HPKE itself is checked against RFC 9180 A.3.1.

base32Refused.why: no whole number of bytes has this length

deriveScalar.note: a sync key whose sync box needs a second candidate

refused.why: no v or app (the old vector's shape)

cases.rule: a remove beats any concurrent change by the device it removes
two devices remove each other: the one added earlier (lower seq of its own add) wins
otherwise the lower hash wins; the loser's author signs it again with the next seq and the new head as prev
